messages:
Ava: Quick Q 11 I'm flying into SF next Tue with my mom. She needs gluten-free and prefers low-sodium. Looking for a calm sit-down dinner near Market & 5th around 7pm. Any recs?
Ben: @Ava Try Harbor Table (two blocks from Market). They mark GF and can do lower-salt requests. Good for quieter evenings.
Sara: Harbor Table +1. Ask for the back dining room, it's much calmer. Also they do a GF polenta.
Owen: If you want somewhere with a private nook, check The Fold (link: https://thefold.example). They do customizable plates and noted allergy flags.
Mei: The Fold is nice but a smidge pricey. For budget + calm, try Green Lantern Cafe 11 tiny menu, great GF rice bowls and mellow vibe.
Carlos: Pro tip: call and request "low-sodium" in the allergy notes 1 restaurants usually accommodate.
Ava: Thanks all. Any idea about high chair accessibility? Mom uses a cane but not a chair.
Ben: Harbor Table is wheelchair ramped and staff are great with extra seating.
Sara: The Fold has narrow entry so maybe avoid if mobility is a concern.
Owen: Green Lantern confirmed ramp and wide aisles when I called last month.
Ava: Awesome. Quick poll: Harbor Table (calm, mid price), Green Lantern (casual, cheap), The Fold (nicer, pricier). Vote with emoji.
Ben: Harbor Table :white_check_mark:
Sara: Harbor Table :white_check_mark:
Mei: Green Lantern :thumbsup:
Carlos: Harbor Table :white_check_mark: (but Green Lantern for budget)
Ava: Harbor Table it is. Anyone around who can call and ask about a corner table/low-salt menu?
Ben: I can call now and hold 7pm for 2 under "Ava".
Ava: You're the best, thank you so much!
Ben: Called, hold placed for Tue 7:00pm under "Ava". Confirmation HT-209. They noted GF + low-sodium.
Ava: Huge relief. Appreciate the quick help 11 will report back after. :heart:
Mei: Safe travels and enjoy dinner with your mom!
